text:
Carla: FYI I opened a docs PR to update the model cards for NovaX-7B and Ember3B — limits, benchmarks, and compatibility notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789. Need reviewers for: SDK snippet, benchmark numbers, runtime compatibility callouts.

Sam: Thanks — quick skim. The `max_input_tokens` and `max_total_tokens` look swapped in the Ember3B card (lines ~45-52). Also the embeddings throughput row is missing units.

Leo: Noted. Runtime compatibility: NovaX-7B quant profile requires `kv_cache=false` on runtime versions < 2.4.0 or you'll hit regen errors for long-context. Suggest adding a small compatibility table.

docsbot: PR #789 created by carla — CI checks started. (docs-lint, link-check, bench-ci).

Josh: I can take the SDK snippet. Planning to add a Python + JS example that shows streaming + function-calling fallback. Will push a commit with tests.

Marie: Re: benchmarks — I re-ran the Ember3B bench on p4d-8x with our standard harness (seq=2048, batch=4). Results attached: tokens/s = 1,320 (median), 95p = 1,050. The doc currently lists 1,500 which was from an older run (different batch shape). I'll upload the CSV to the PR. Link to CSV: https://internal-storage/redwood/bench/ember3b/2026-03-20.csv

Sam: Good call. Also noticed the example config uses `sequence_limit: 4096` but the runtime seq ceiling for NovaX is 8192 on Dedicated; we should call out per-deployment differences.

Carla: Added a new section "Deployment-specific limits" and a small compatibility matrix (Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private). Also fixed the Ember3B token units and swapped the tokens fields as Sam noted. PTAL. If ok I'll merge after signoffs.

Leo: I left one inline comment about the quant note — suggest exact wording: "For runtime < 2.4.0, use model variant `novax-7b-int8-no-kv` or enable `kv_cache=false` to avoid regen on long context." 

Josh: Pushed SDK snippet commit linking to the new example. Snippet (Python) included:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="novaX-7b", prompt="Explain KV cache")
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
I also added a comment about falling back to `ember3b-lite` if latency policy triggers.

Marie: CSV uploaded and bench-ci re-run passed. I bumped the doc numbers to match the new median and left the 95p in a footnote.

Carla: Awesome — looks much cleaner. Any objections to merging before EOD? We want this in the nightly docs deploy so the infra team can pick up the compat table for the runtime routing changes.

Sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

Leo: LGTM, added a short note about routing fallback to aurora-lite3b for degraded GPU capacity.

Carla: Merging now. Will add a release note in #release-war-room and ping infra for routing policy. Thanks all!
